mapper.select: select p.member_id as memberId, m.nickname as nickname, m.avatar as avatar, count(*) as score, max(coalesce(p.checkin_time, p.create_time)) as finishedAt from player_node_progress p join cms_topic t on t.id = p.topic_id and t.del_flag = 0 join ums_member m on m.id = p.member_id and m.del_flag = 0 where group by p.member_id, m.nickname, m.avatar order by score desc, finishedAt asc, memberId asc limit #{limit}

select p.member_id as memberId, m.nickname as nickname, m.avatar as avatar, count(*) as score, max(coalesce(p.checkin_time, p.create_time)) as finishedAt from player_node_progress p join cms_topic t on t.id = p.topic_id and t.del_flag = 0 join ums_member m on m.id = p.member_id and m.del_flag = 0 where and p.member_id = #{memberId} group by p.member_id, m.nickname, m.avatar

select case when count(mine.memberId) = 0 then null else count(peers.memberId) + 1 end as userRank from (select p.member_id as memberId, count(*) as score, max(coalesce(p.checkin_time, p.create_time)) as finishedAt from player_node_progress p join cms_topic t on t.id = p.topic_id and t.del_flag = 0 join ums_member m on m.id = p.member_id and m.del_flag = 0 where and p.member_id = #{memberId} group by p.member_id) mine left join (select p.member_id as memberId, count(*) as score, max(coalesce(p.checkin_time, p.create_time)) as finishedAt from player_node_progress p join cms_topic t on t.id = p.topic_id and t.del_flag = 0 join ums_member m on m.id = p.member_id and m.del_flag = 0 where group by p.member_id) peers on peers.score > mine.score or (peers.score = mine.score and (peers.finishedAt < mine.finishedAt or (peers.finishedAt = mine.finishedAt and peers.memberId < mine.memberId)))
